descFull: Adds variables to python traceback. Simple, lightweight, controllable. Customize formats and colors. Debug reasons of exceptions by logging or pretty printing colorful variable contexts for each frame in a stacktrace, showing every value. Dump locals environments after errors to console, files, and loggers. Works in Jupyter too.
